messages:
Nora H.: Heads up — brief P95 spike on /v1/stream at 04:11 UTC, user-facing latency. Opening this thread to capture short-term SLO adjustments and owners for follow-ups.

Evan (oncall): Error budget burn ~12% in 12h, spike lasted ~18m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/s/stream-latency. P95 jumped 2.5x, throughput steady.

Diego M.: Traces point to intermittent KV-cache misses that caused backend fanout and batching pressure. Looks like a cache warming regression from the last deploy.

Priya K.: I'll own cache heuristics rollback and a targeted canary. Creating ticket INF-2100: "restore cache prewarm + reduce batch window". ETA 24h. Link: https://tickets.redwood/internal/INF-2100.

Nora H.: Propose temporary P95 SLO relaxation 220ms -> 280ms for 24h to avoid alert storms while canary runs. We keep P99 and throughput SLO as-is. Approve?

Evan (oncall): Approved for 24h. I'll update alert thresholds (P95 -> 300ms) and add 30m suppression window. Will post PR link.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-215 created: stream latency spike due to cache-miss fanout. Severity: Sev3. Pager muted per oncall.

Priya K.: Canary config (small):
```
canary_nodes: 2
cache_preload=true
batch_timeout_ms: 12
```
Starting canary now and will report back in 45m.

Diego M.: I'll update the SLO dashboard to show cache-miss rate and per-backend fanout to make future detection faster. PR: https://git.redwood/dashboards/pulls/501.

Evan (oncall): Alert PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pulls/210 — threshold bumped and suppression added.

Priya K.: Canary looks good — P95 back to ~190ms on canary nodes, cache-miss rate down. Rolling to 30% traffic.

Nora H.: Recording owners and timelines: Priya -> INF-2100 (24h), Diego -> dashboard PR, Evan -> alert change. Temporary SLO change applied at 04:35 UTC, rollback scheduled +24h. Follow-up retro next weekly SRE sync.

Evan (oncall): Error budget burn slowed to 3% in the 6h after canary. Monitoring for 24h before closing loop.

Priya K.: INF-2100 resolved after full rollout. Perf: https://perf.redwood/results/inf-2100-final.

Nora H.: SLO restored at 1981235600. Closing thread — thanks team.

(End of thread)
